description: Na₃YCl₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-47°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.71-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.26 Å. Y is bonded to six Cl atoms to form YCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-47°. There are a spread of Y-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.62-2.65 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to three Na and one Y atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Y trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to three Na and one Y atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Y trigonal pyramids. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Y atom.
